name: Oil pump assembly
what: The oil pump draws oil from the sump and pressurizes it so oil can circulate through the engine.
why: A steady supply of pressurized oil lubricates the crankshaft bearings and other moving parts.
where: The pump mounts to the timing-belt end of the B-series block, around the front of the crankshaft.
installationReason: Install the rotating assembly first. The oil pump mounts at the timing-belt end of the block around the crankshaft nose.
